title: The discovery projection is populated, idempotent, and loses no updates

commands.note: 17 passed — the existing discovery tests are unchanged and still pass

cases.note: The writer populates the projection at all. discovery_projection.rs::the_writer_populates_the_projection — the projection is empty before the pass and contains the profile after it.

A profile with no favorites is still projected as a profile. ::a_profile_with_no_favorites_is_still_projected — the discovery_profiles row exists with its nickname and bio and zero favorites; ::a_profile_with_no_favorites_claims_no_shared_interest — it is absent from another viewer's people list, so it never claims a shared interest.
Deleted profiles disappear. ::a_deleted_profile_disappears_from_the_projection — after the source soft-deletes, the projection row and its favorites are gone and the profile is no longer discovered.
Idempotent. ::the_writer_is_idempotent rewinds the watermark and replays: the same rows, no duplicates. ::applying_the_same_page_twice_is_a_no_op asserts the profile count is unchanged.

No lost updates. ::an_update_after_a_pass_is_not_lost changes the favorites after the pass caught up and requires the later change in the projection. ::a_visibility_change_reaches_the_projection does the same for visibility.
Concurrent writers converge. ::concurrent_writers_converge_without_losing_updates runs two writers at once and requires every subject present and no duplicate rows.
The watermark names a real source row. ::the_watermark_advances_only_to_the_source_cursor.

No fabricated data. ::an_absent_source_field_is_projected_absent (null bio, null interaction_style, null image) and ::a_favorite_without_a_catalog_row_is_not_fabricated (the profile is projected; the unlabelled favorite is dropped, not given an invented label).
A source failure leaves the projection untouched. ::a_source_failure_leaves_the_projection_untouched — an empty projection would be a fabricated fact.

The no-score property survives. ::the_writer_adds_no_score_column walks information_schema for every discovery_* table; ::the_writer_bookkeeping_is_not_a_ranking asserts the run table names no profile. The unchanged tests/discovery.rs::the_response_contains_no_numeric_score_field still passes.

limitations: The block source is a port, not a wired consumer. blocks.rs turns a resolved BlockState into a projection row and is tested; resolving a FRIEND_RELATIONSHIP_CHANGED pair signal to that state through the relationship authority is the caller's job and is not wired into a running worker in this package.
The job is not scheduled by a running service. ProjectionWriter::run_pass is the unit of work and is fully tested; mounting it on a periodic worker in concert-service main is a composition step.

The gRPC source (GrpcDiscoverySource) is implemented and compiles but is not exercised by a live two-service test; the tests use the real profile-service query against the profile database through the DiscoverySource port, which is the same code path minus the transport.
